question: Who among the following players is related to table tennis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manika Batra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Manika Batra** is an Indian table tennis player, known for her significant contributions to the sport in India.
 
• She won a gold medal at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** in the women's singles event.
 
• Manika Batra also led the Indian women's team to a historic gold medal in the team event at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.
 
• She has been honored with the **Arjuna Award** for her achievements in table tennis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis:**

 
 
• Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small bats.
 
• The game takes place on a hard table divided by a net. The objective is to score points by striking the ball so that the opponent fails to return it.
 
• It is governed by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF), founded in 1926.
 
• Table tennis is an Olympic sport and has several categories, including singles, doubles, and team events.
 
 
 
• **Other Players Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Manish Narwal** is a para-shooter who competes in the SH1 category.
 
• **K Srikanth** is an Indian badminton player who has won several international titles.
 
• **Pankaj Advani** is an Indian billiards and snooker player, known for his numerous world titles in both sports.
